description.value: Hotel Viewmont is a hotel and restaurant in Logan Lake, BC, operating since 1995 with 24/7 front-desk reception. It offers standard rooms with in-room microwaves and refrigerators alongside an on-site restaurant. A complimentary shuttle to Kamloops Airport is available, making it a serviceable base for cyclists passing through the Thompson-Okanagan region.

address.value: 19 Apex Dr, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hotelviewmont.com corroborates the OSM address (19 Apex Dr, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0), phone (+1 250-299-9019), and email, confirming the listing is real and open. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly listed as an in-room amenity across multiple pages, and the hotel operates an on-site restaurant branded as 'Hotel & Restaurant', supporting nearby evening food. No bike-specific information (storage, charging, tools, wash) appears anywhere on the website, so all cyclist-specific criteria remain null; however, two concerns warrant flagging: the About page lists 'Arun - Software Engineer' under hotel leadership (a template-site artefact), and room descriptions are internally inconsistent (twin beds vs. queen-sized beds for the same room type).
concerns: Website shows signs of being template-based: the About page lists 'Arun - Software Engineer' under hotel leadership, which is atypical and suggests a partially populated demo site.
Room description inconsistency: the /rooms listing says 'Standard Twin Room - two twin beds' while the /rooms/2 detail page says 'two queen-sized beds' for the same room.
OSM address field lacks city and postal code; full address (Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0) confirmed from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating hotel at a confirmed address with consistent contact details across OSM and website; open to the public and useful to touring cyclists as accommodation with an on-site restaurant.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant operated by the hotel, branded throughout site as 'Hotel & Restaurant'
